primary_claim: An attacker who controls a model's weights can apply a cheap, behavior-preserving weight-symmetry transform (a basis change in attention V/O, or a permutation in the MLP hidden dimension) that relocates the basis an Introspection Adapter (IA) auditor was calibrated against, dropping IA verbalization of injected malicious behavior from 100% to 0-20% across seven published fine-tunes with no observable change in model outputs.

effect.metric: IA verbalization rate of injected malicious behavior

contradicts_or_qualifies: Contradicts the robustness of Introspection Adapters (Shenoy et al., 2026) by showing the technique is defeated under a threat model (adversary controls released weights) different from the one its authors assumed (adversary controls only training data)

Qualifies Safe LoRA's (arXiv:2405.16833) robustness by showing its 'safe subspace' check can be evaded by an adversary who obfuscates a weight update via a canceling basis change before/after the value and output matrices

Qualifies Representation Engineering-style linear probes (arXiv:2310.01405) by showing a consistent permutation of the residual stream basis defeats a probe fit in the old coordinates while preserving model behavior
quote: IA verbalization 100% → 0–20% across seven published fine-tunes
